key_insight: Vibe-FDTR turns natural-language requests into reproducible FDTR analysis by pairing LLM agents with a configuration-driven, physically consistent domain codebase.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the expertise barrier for thermal metrology while improving reliability, speed, and cost efficiency for microscale heat-transport characterization.
method: Agent skills translate user intent into ordered, verifiable FDTR analysis steps.
A configuration-driven code package enforces physical and parameter consistency.
An optional expert mode performs sensitivity and uncertainty analysis for planning.
evidence_signal: In benchmark tests, Vibe-FDTR achieved 100% success on synthetic single-step tasks and 98.9% on real-data multi-step tasks, outperforming ablated variants.
watch_item: Results depend on a tightly integrated domain package and skill design, so robustness may drop if the FDTR configuration, physical assumptions, or workflow constraints are not carefully maintained.
paper_title: Vibe-FDTR: An agent-oriented framework for reproducible frequency-domain thermoreflectance data analysis
